name: special-offer
title: Special Offer Banner
description: A full-width bar for a limited-time sale: copy on the left, a countdown of days, hours, minutes and seconds in the middle, and a boxed discount code on the right. It ticks down each second, then swaps to an ended message.
use: You want a loud, self-contained sale banner that keeps the deadline visible while the page is open.
avoid: The target date, copy and promo code are hardcoded, so every new campaign needs a source edit.
a11y: The ticking countdown is plain text and never announced to screen readers; the pulsing colons ignore reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: n-a, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark bar with a warm orange glow behind the left copy, fading to near-black on the right. The left column holds a small blue label, a white headline and a highlighted paragraph. Four square countdown tiles follow, the first orange and the rest blue, split by colons, ending in a bordered promo-code box.
behaves: The countdown drops once per second while the four tiles keep their values padded to two digits. Once the target date passes, the banner is replaced by a short 'Sale Ended!' message. Nothing responds to hover, click or keyboard.
customise: No props: the sale copy, promo code and countdown target date are written into the file, so changing them means editing the source. Colours come from utility classes.
weight: light: One interval per second updating four numbers; nothing heavy renders.
demo: Cyber sale copy advertising 30% off with the code CBRLAYOUT, counting down to 31 December 2026.
issues: The promo code box runs off the right edge in every frame
The 'Limited Time Offer' label is clipped at the top
The left copy column is narrow, leaving a wide empty gap before the countdown
polishWhy: Coherent glow and countdown, but cramped copy column and clipped edges keep it ordinary.

frames.note: Promo code box is clipped by the right edge and the 'Limited Time Offer' label is cut off at the top.
